name: Game Ideation Skills
description: A collection of AI agent skills for game ideation and early game development workflows, based on the Daniel Dumont workshop methodology. The skill `init-game-docs` is the foundation — it scaffolds the document structure and owns the shared workshop reference files that all other skills read from. Install `init-game-docs` first; install other skills only as needed.

skills.description: Scaffolds the standard Dumont-style game design document structure (Game Idea, Core Mechanic, Exposé, etc.) and provides the shared workshop reference files in its references/ folder. Prerequisite for all other skills in this marketplace.
Co-develops the Game Idea document (stage 1 of the Dumont methodology). Reads workshop background from init-game-docs/references/.
